name: @scfloworg/repl-conformance
description: A REPL-level, format-agnostic vitest suite: fixtures (seed + a script of raw command-block text + expectations on named results) run through the real REPL command-block parser (@scfloworg/repl's runCommandBlock), not direct runCommand calls — so a fixture also exercises the parsing/validation path a human typing at the prompt goes through (resolveCommandForm's unknown-key rejection included). See README.md.
